notes.title: Update Notes For November 3rd
notes.content:
-Minor optimization improvements
-Fixed issues with some of the bosses not attacking
-Fixed issues with crosshair not showing up in some cases

notes.title: Update notes for 24 october
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where some of the sprites don't get rendered
-Items now can't be walked on

notes.title: Update Notes for October 3
notes.content:
- You can't now walk on shopkeepers
- Fixed a bug where if you walk on sawblade from it's right while you're shooting, it would teleport you 20 feet in the air (I don't know why either)

notes.title: Update Notes 1st October 2
notes.content:
-Some bullets are more visible now
-fixed an issue where Enemy 14 made sounds even after death

notes.title: Update Notes for 1st October
notes.content:
- More sound adjusting
- Increased step height for characters to not make them stuck in some corridors

notes.title: Update Notes for 28 Sept.
notes.content:
Bugs:

- Adjusted some of the sounds 
- Added a Cooldown on an elevator to next lvl's so that it doesnt send you there straight away if you stand in the middle of the room

Optimization:

- Some unnecesary Particles were removed to save on the performance
- Changed the way of how the floor and rooms are spawned to not cause any issues
- Fixed the enemies trying to set the healthbar they don't have

Overall the game should no longer occasionally crash but i'll tell you if something changes.
